text:
maya (Product Designer): quick idea: a 'soft revoke' pattern for API keys where we show an undo window instead of immediate permanent disable. sketch attached in figma.

sam (PM): sounds user friendly. legal asked for a way for org admins to bypass undo for compliance. can we expose a force-revoke toggle in the modal?

jordan (Frontend): technical note: if the key remains usable during undo, that's a security hole. i assume requests should 403 immediately and undo just flips state back. confirm?

maya (Product Designer): yes — UX proposal: status = revoked_pending, backend rejects calls (403). toast shows 'Key revoked · Undo (30s)' with focus on Undo. aria role=alert.

lee (Eng Manager): backend requirements: audit events for pending and confirmed revokes. if undone emit revoked_undone. For dedicated customers we must ensure cross-region consistency.

maya (Product Designer): copy options for the toast: 'API key disabled. Undo (30s) — will become permanent after timer.' or short: 'Key disabled — Undo'. Need SR-friendly wording.

jordan (Frontend): implementation nits: Undo must be a button, keyboard tabbable, and not dismissable by Esc. make sure screen readers get the consequence line.

sam (PM): rotate flow question: if someone rotates while a key is in pending revoke, do we block rotate or allow and confirm?

maya (Product Designer): two options: A) disable Rotate until undo window finishes with tooltip 'Finish revoke undo window or force revoke to rotate.' B) allow rotate but show conflict modal explaining rotate will confirm revoke. Which do we prefer?

lee (Eng Manager): A reduces backend complexity and race conditions. prefer that.

jordan (Frontend): secret reveal copy: 'New secret generated. Copy now — this value will not be shown again.' also link aria-describedby to helper text and ensure color contrast meets 4.5:1.

maya (Product Designer): empty credentials page layout: left column illustration + short sentence, right column quick CTAs (Create key, Bulk rotate, Grant role). alt text: 'illustration: person holding a key' — is that descriptive enough?

sam (PM): add hint under Create: 'Use scopes to limit exposure — learn more' linking to docs. show a permission badge on each key row (Read-only / Full) so intent is clear.

jordan (Frontend): accessibility: badges need screenreader labels like 'Perms: read-only' and keyboard filter controls. color contrast for badges must hit 4.5:1.

maya (Product Designer): modal copy for force revoke: "Are you sure you want to revoke this API key? Revoking will immediately disable the key across all environments." Buttons: '[Force revoke] [Cancel]'. Add tiny line: 'Admins can force revoke even during undo windows.'

sam (PM): analytics events: revoke_initiated, revoke_confirmed, revoke_undone, revoke_forced with workspace and actor.

access-bot: policy check: org:acme-corp requires immediate revocation. force revoke will bypass undo and log compliance.note.

maya (Product Designer): action items: 1) jordan — prototype toast + keyboard/SR behavior; 2) lee — add audit events and undo API; 3) sam — update PRD with admin toggle and analytics; 4) me — produce mocks and copy variants in Figma.

sam (PM): timeline: prototype this week so legal can review.

jordan (Frontend): i can produce a keyboard/SR prototype tomorrow.

lee (Eng Manager): backend ETA: 2 sprints for undo endpoint; can scope earlier if we prioritize.

maya (Product Designer): Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/soft-revoke-cred-flow — please comment your preferred toast text and any copy changes. :sparkles:
